releases.summary: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

releases.name: Graveyard Keeper 2
releases.summary:
You are the Grand Inquisitor now! Restore the Town and lead your undead army into battle to save the realm from a zombie apocalypse. 

Welcome to Graveyard Keeper 2 - the sequel to the original, unhinged classic!

Build and manage your own medieval graveyard. Harvest as much flora, fauna, and human remains as you can to build extraordinary machinery, automate production, and expand your graveyard for pure profit.

Help the townsfolk restore their homes and turn their problems into revenue. Help the townsfolk rebuild their homes and complete quests throughout the city, as your undead workers take care of the heavy lifting behind the scenes. With zombie-based automation and structured systems, you can transform local efforts into a scalable and profitable operation.

releases.name: RED HALLWAYS: Horror
releases.summary:
You wake up in a strange place made up of endless red hallways. The exit is only a few steps away, but it's locked. To escape, you'll need to search the maze, solve puzzles, and uncover the key before it's too late.

You're not alone.

Something is wandering the hallways, and it's hunting you.

releases.name: Aero the Acro-Bat Legacy + Sunsoft Lost Gems
The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
releases.summary:
Every Who down in Who-ville is jingling, singing and celebrating. And guess who can’t wait to join them… the Grinch! Now, with a heart three sizes bigger, and a wish to show the Whos he’s changed, could the Grinch’s prize-winning tree be the perfect way to prove it?

Play as the Grinch and Jumbo-Jump through snowy 3D worlds, collecting ornaments to make your tree sparkle brighter with every step. Overcome platforming challenges, explore every nook and cranny, and use the clever gadgets you find to get through each level. Unleash the Snowball Maker to freeze mischievous adversaries, launch into action with the Rocket Skates, and reach new heights with the Jetpack.

Each level is filled with festive adventures. Hop through the Grinch’s Cave, dodging falling stalactites and zipping down watery chutes. Conquer Mt. Crumpit’s slippery ice and giant rolling snowballs. Find your way through Who-wood’s towering trees and springy mushrooms. Then explore Who-ville, leaping across hovering platforms and sneaking into the Whos’ cozy homes. Use your candy canes to break objects and release dazzling ornaments to decorate the Grinch’s Christmas tree and Who-ville Square.

Adventure solo or team up in local co-op mode. Together with Max, you’ll have fun outsmarting pesky mice, wild forest bats and other curious creatures. Uncover hidden paths and collect every sparkly decoration you can find to make your tree shine.

Make it a merry day in Who-ville, spread Christmas cheer, and create the most spectacular tree the Whos have ever seen!

releases.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
releases.summary: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon and Michonne in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

releases.name: Scary Ring
releases.summary: It makes such a lovely day today and cute Carol decided to walk to school instead of taking the bus! She get dressed up really quickly, she packed the books, notebooks and the pencils needed today and she headed to school! Don't you imagine girls that Carol's journey from home to schools is a boring one...she has to solve many obstacles she will meet on her way in order to advance on the road! The first thing she needs to deal with are two crying babies...they need their toys, that's it, but their mom can't manage to find them, so make sure you check her bag for that candy-colored ball and for that yellow baby nipple! Problem solved, but here comes the next one: The ice cream seller asked her to please help him arrange the treats and because she will receive a free one as a gift for her help, Carol instantly started placing each ice cream to the right place, so how about helping her finish this job a bit earlier? Once this problem solved Carlo's adventure continues with a new challenge that you girls are going to discover on your own once you manage to reach the third level of the game! Good luck an have fun!

releases.name: Tristia: Restore
releases.summary:
In order to rebuild the desolate oceanic city Tristia, the genius inventor girl "Nanoca Franca" begins a big strategy to revitalize the city!

"Tristia: Restore" is an action game based on the PC game "Tristia in the Blue Sea" released by Kogado Studio in 2002. 

Requests for the invention and production of items are constantly pouring in at Nanoka's workshop, which has come to revitalize the deserted town.
It's not just work that uses your head, but sometimes you have to run around the workshop from right to left to fulfill requests.

There are clear conditions for each stage. Clear when all the conditions are met before the time limit ends! You can proceed to the next story/stage.

releases.name: Mr. Sleepy Man
releases.summary: Mr. Sleepy Man is up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

releases.name: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure
releases.summary:
Classic literature meets classic gaming in Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure! 

Explore 8-bit England, fight enemies with your quill, and confront characters from Jane Austen's novels!

releases.name: Tristia: Legacy
releases.summary:
"Tristia of the Blue Sea" has been fully renewed with graphics and revived in the latest environment! We will deliver it to everyone under the title of "Tristia: Legacy".

In the simulation part, you can enjoy the super-realistic town development simulation that has been well received, and in the adventure part, you can enjoy a hot story that interweaves comics and seriousness unfolding in Tristia.

Experience the story of the origin and beginning of the long-running Tristia series with graphics that have been completely revised for modern times while retaining the fun of inventing in the workshop.

releases.name: Another Eden Begins
releases.summary:
Aldo and his younger sister, Feinne, enjoy a peaceful life in the idyllic village of Baruoki, until one day, when Feinne is taken by the Beast King. 

Aldo pursues them into the Moonlight Forest, but following a fierce battle with a beast, he is sent through a tear in spacetime - and finds himself in a world 800 years in the future.

Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

releases.name: Shape Wars
releases.summary:
Shape Wars is a fast-paced local multiplayer strategy game where geometric armies clash for dominance. Build your base, spawn units, upgrade your forces, and deploy devastating EMPs or pilot a Commander to turn the tide of battle.

Play solo against cunning AI opponents or go head-to-head with up to 4 players in Free For All, Teams, or AI Teams mode. Capture resource points, upgrade damage and shields, and outmaneuver your rivals to be the last shape standing.

releases.name: Doorway to Nightmares: Terrifying Tales
releases.summary:
Chilling tales await. Uncover fear in the art.

When you finally expose the truth behind the story, can you handle what it reveals?

Some scares hide in plain sight.
Read eerie situations, study the illustration, and solve each mystery like a detective in a horror tale.

How to play is simple:
・Read the question carefully
・Find the matching clue hidden in the illustration
・Tap the spot you think answers the prompt
・With each correct answer, the story’s truth comes into clearer focus

Perfect for fans of horror, mystery games, and quick deduction puzzles.
Step through the doorway, follow the clues, and see what is waiting in the dark.
